title: Direct Scattering of the Focusing Nonlinear Schrödinger Equation with Step-like Oscillatory Initial Data
summary: In this manuscript we set up the direct and inverse scattering problems for step-like traveling-wave solutions of the nonlinear Schrödinger equation. Specifically, we consider initial data $u(x,0)$ satisfying $u(x,0)\to u_0^\ell(x)$ as $x\to-\infty$ and $u(x,0)\to u_0^r(x)$ as $x\to+\infty$, where $u_0^\ell(x)$ and $u_0^r(x)$ are elliptic traveling waves. Under suitable assumptions on the initial data we formulate the direct scattering problem and establish analytic properties of the scattering data.
